references.text: The previous verse explains that a portion is to be taken as a contribution to the Lord from the share of the warriors
Moses gave the contribution to the priest Eleazar as a gift to the Lord, just as the Lord had commanded
The Lord gave the priests responsibility for the gifts that were lifted up as wave offerings
All holy gifts that the Israelites bring to the Lord, the Lord gives to Aaron and his sons
Instructions on giving a tenth as a gift lifted up for the Lord
Refers to the contribution (terumah) belonging to the priest Aaron and his sons
